knownBlockers.issue: Render service has no JWT_SECRET; admin login fails with "secretOrPrivateKey must have a value".
knownBlockers.action: Set JWT_SECRET on the Render service and redeploy.

knownBlockers.issue: Vercel /api/settings still returns NovaCart because Atlas holds the old settings document.
knownBlockers.action: Update Atlas settings (requires a Render admin token or the real Atlas URI).

knownBlockers.issue: Product and category image paths collide in production, so updated product images also changed category imagery.
knownBlockers.action: Repoint category.image to distinct paths in Atlas.

knownBlockers.issue: Uploads are written to Render local disk and are lost on redeploy.
knownBlockers.action: Move uploads to durable object storage.

knownBlockers.issue: JWT is persisted in localStorage; tokenVersion provides revocation-on-password-change but not on explicit logout or theft.
knownBlockers.action: Move to httpOnly cookie refresh tokens.

knownBlockers.issue: MongoDB is standalone, so checkout cannot use multi-document transactions; relies on atomic per-doc guards plus compensating rollback.
knownBlockers.action: Convert to a replica set for true ACID checkout.
